pages.text: Two **Wheels**, a row of planks for the bed, and two slabs on top. Make the wheels first.

pages.title: Hitch and Haul
pages.text: Slot the cart into the **Upgraded Saddle** and it appears behind your horse, rolling along as you ride. It shares the stabilizer's slot, so a horse carries one or the other - not both.

pages.title: Room for Four
pages.text: An empty cart seats four. Two share the driver's bench up front - whoever takes it first drives the horse - and two more ride in the bed behind. Small animals that wander into the bed climb aboard on their own; **sneak** and right-click to set everyone in the back down again.

pages.title: Fitting a Chest
pages.text:
Right-click the cart with a **Chest** in hand to mount it in the bed. **Sneak** and right-click the cart to open it - a full **double chest** of room, and the lid swings up while you're browsing.

The chest fills the bed, so a cart hauling cargo carries no back-seat passengers - the driver's bench still seats two.

pages.title: Taking It Off
pages.text:
**Shears** take the chest back off and drop it beside the horse. Empty it first - a loaded chest refuses to come off rather than spill across the road.

While a chest is fitted, the cart itself is locked into its gear slot; the slot flashes **red** if you try to pull it out. Shear the chest off first, then unhitch the cart.
